item.text:
The report now documents twenty-two reproduced findings at [report.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_08-26-31-zookeeper-baseline/work/report.md).

This continuation added **F22: a missing or unreadable oracle is treated as permission to follow a leader**. `QuorumOracleMaj.askOracle()` returns `false` both for a legitimate `0` response and for an I/O failure. In the election path, `!askOracle()` is interpreted as authorization to follow. The repro produced:

```
java.io.FileNotFoundException: nullnull (No such file or directory)
  at QuorumOracleMaj.askOracle(QuorumOracleMaj.java:84)
result with missing oracle: (2, 5, 1)
AssertionError: missing oracle was treated as permission to follow a leader
```

Reproduction: [OracleMissingRepro.java](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_08-26-31-zookeeper-baseline/work/repro/oracle_missing/org/apache/zookeeper/server/quorum/OracleMissingRepro.java).

This is a safety issue in two-voter oracle deployments: an unavailable safety oracle should fail closed rather than authorize following. The prior twenty-one findings remain documented, covering snapshot fallback, recovery/truncation, malformed packets and transactions, oracle election/revalidation, duplicate/gap proposals, epoch initialization, and storage bookkeeping. All reproduction files and observed outputs remain under `repro/`; the captured source was not modified.
